data.research_question: What is the finest defensible current public headquarters geography for Vulcan Elements, and what current evidence advances its unresolved OSC financing due-diligence target?
data.method: Enumerated 27 physical digs roots on current main. Excluded free-range as the planner meta-root and excluded devil-corp, cloarida, and trump-netanyahu as the previous three successful hourly selections, leaving 23 eligible roots. Run seed 17976700377031726005 was derived from SHA-256(eca73e87f8bd689490c603af54f15cfa477c8436|2026-08-18T18:00:00Z|hourly-auto-dig|dataset-first-v1). The seeded dataset permutation drew canada-policy-influence first, but its canonical packet contains only a completed depth-0 research-pass and no queued target, so it was rejected as non-actionable rather than inventing a target. The next draw, palantir, exposed five connector-verifiable queued targets:starintel:investigation-target:palantir-org-id-resolution, starintel:investigation-target:depth-8-irs-palantir-control-documents, starintel:investigation-target:depth-6-barbaccia-agency-ethics-file, starintel:investigation-target:depth-6-rockbridge-interentity-ledger, and starintel:investigation-target:depth-6-vulcan-osc-due-diligence. Target seed 14832685738744562103 selected the Vulcan OSC target. HQ enrichment separates Vulcan’s explicit Research Triangle Park headquarters locality from the precise 12 TW Alexander Dr federal-award recipient address published by USAspending. Reuters’ July 10 report materially supports that the Vulcan $620 million OSC loan remained on track while ReElement withdrew from its separate $80 million loan, but does not resolve Vulcan closing, disbursement, warrants/equity, credit conditions, or decision-process records. A current August search of Vulcan’s first-party updates and reputable news found no material new Vulcan-specific development after that evidence, so no filler current-news event was created. The exact whole-corpus actionable-target count is not fabricated because connector indexing does not execute the full Free-Range DB+packet terminal-state, blocker, deduplication, discovered-candidate, and legacy-transport pass.
classification_rules: exclude the previous three successful hourly roots when alternatives exist
reject a drawn dataset only when no safely status-filtered actionable queue exists
explicit headquarters locality does not automatically establish a headquarters street
federal award recipient address is not automatically headquarters
conditional or on-track financing is not closing or disbursement
do not create current-news filler when no material non-duplicate update is found

findings.finding: Vulcan Elements explicitly described its headquarters as being in North Carolina’s Research Triangle Park, supporting Durham/Research Triangle Park headquarters locality.

USAspending publishes 12 TW Alexander Dr, Bldg 200, Ste 100, Durham, NC 27709-0152 as Vulcan Elements Inc.’s recipient address for contract FA864925P0394; the record does not designate that street as headquarters.

Reuters reported on July 10, 2026 that Vulcan’s $620 million OSC loan remained on track while ReElement stopped pursuing its separate $80 million loan; exact Vulcan closing and disbursement remain unresolved.
No material new Vulcan-specific August 2026 development was found in the reviewed current first-party and reputable-news surfaces.
